PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
Any written public record relating to an agenda item for an open session of a regular meeting of the City Council that is distributed to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting will be available for public inspection at City Hall in the City Clerk's office at 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 3rd Floor during normal business hours (Monday - Thursday, 7:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.)

1.
WARRANTS AND DEMANDS Staff recommends City Council receive and file.
STAFF REPORT
2.
PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL Staff recommends City Council approve the preparation and presentation of the plaques, proclamations and certificates as outlined in the staff report.
STAFF REPORT
3.
MINUTES Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of July 6, 2011 and the special meeting of August 17, 2011.
STAFF REPORT
STAFF REPORT
4.
CONSIDERATION TO CANCEL THE LEGISLATIVE BODY MEETINGS OF SEPTEMBER 21, 2011 Staff recommends the City Council cancel the September 21, 2011 meetings and direct the City Clerk to post the appropriate notices of cancellation.
STAFF REPORT
5.
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 1347 Staff recommends City Council read by title only and adopt on second reading, Ordinance No. 1347 entitled, "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK DETERMINING TO COMPLY WITH THE VOLUNTARY ALTERNATIVE REDEVELOPMENT PROGRAM PURSUANT TO PART 1.9 OF DIVISION 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE IN ORDER TO PERMIT THE CONTINUED EXISTENCE AND OPERATION OF THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK."
STAFF REPORT
6.
APPROVAL TO PURCHASE VEHICLES, WAIVE FORMAL BID PROCEDURES AND AUTHORIZE STAFF THE PROCUREMENT AND DETERMINING OTHER MATTERS IN CONNECTION THEREWITH Staff recommends 1) The City Council find (i) that it would be uneconomical to follow purchasing procedures since the vehicles are available at lower prices if purchased through an existing contract with the County and (ii) that the welfare of the public therefore would be promoted by dispensing with the purchasing procedures; and 2) Approved the procurement of six (6) vehicles and authorize staff to finance up to five (5) of the six (6) police vehicles, with principal on the lease not to exceed $250,000. Leased vehicles are to be paid from the Police General Fund budget (Cost Center 340) and the purchased vehicle from Asset Forfeiture Funds (Cost Center 340); and 3) Authorize the Finance Director and/or Chief Executive Officer to enter into a Lease Agreement with Bank of the West and execute all documents reasonably required by Lessor, including but not limited to a Master Lease Agreement, applicable Equipment Schedules, financing statements, Opinion of Counsel and Delivery & Acceptance Certificate.
STAFF REPORT
7.
APPROVAL OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH CASA CARDENAS SENIOR AND FAMILY COUNSELING CENTER Staff recommends City Council approve and sign the Memorandum of Understanding between Casa Cardenas Senior and Family Counseling Center and the City of Baldwin Park.
STAFF REPORT
8.
COST ANALYSIS AND EXTENSION OF CONTRACT FOR JANITORIAL SERVICES FOR CITY FACILITIES Staff recommends City Council award the Janitorial Service Contract to United Maintenance Systems, Inc. for a monthly fee of $9,385.00 for a period of one (1) year and authorize the Mayor to execute the contract.
STAFF REPORT
9.
AUTHORIZATION TO PROCEED WITH THE DESIGN OF A TRAFFIC SIGNAL AT THE BALDWIN PARK BOULEVARD & STEWART AVENUE INTERSECTION AND THEREAFTER SOLICIT CONSTRUCTION BIDS Staff recommends City Council 1) Authorize staff to engage a traffic engineer to update the warrant Study and to complete the Traffic Signal Plans, Specifications, and prepare the bid package in an amount not to exceed $15,000; and 2) Authorize the appropriation of $175,000 of Prop 1B funds so there is funding available for construction.
STAFF REPORT
10.
AWARD A CONTRACT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE PROP 1B CITYWIDE STREET IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT - PHASE II TO COPP CONTRACTING, INC. IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,016,143 Staff recommends City Council 1) Award a Construction Contract to COPP Contracting, Inc. in the amount of $1,016,143; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached agreement; and 3) Authorize the Director of Public works to execute any necessary change orders in an amount not to exceed five percent (5%) of the original contract; and 4) Authorize additional work by COPP Contracting in the amount of $115,000; and 5) Approve the attached Resolution which would make eligible for funding the Traffic Signal at Baldwin Park Boulevard/Stewart Avenue intersection and the use of Prop 1B funds in the amount of 470,000 as the required match for the ARRA funded Ramona B improvements (instead of using Prop C funds).
STAFF REPORT
11.
AWARD A CONTRACT FOR LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICES TO MARIPOSA LANDSCAPE IN THE AMOUNT OF $67,320 PER YEAR FOR A THREE (3) YEAR TERM Staff recommends City Council award a landscape Services Contract to mariposa for maintenance of the medians for a three (3) year term in the monthly amount of $5,610 or $67,320 annually, and authorize the Mayor to execute the attached agreement.
STAFF REPORT
12.
CITY COUNCIL CONSIDERATION AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2011-040 IN SUPPORT AND APPROVAL OF AN APPLICATION FOR THE EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT (JAG) PROGRAM Staff recommends, after considering any testimony received, the City Council waive further reading, read by title only and adopt Resolution No. 2011-040 entitled, "RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK CITY COUNCIL EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR AND APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR THE EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT (JAG) PROGRAM."
STAFF REPORT
